The empty states and first-save all work. Open http://maker:4001/empty.html — this is the app **as a brand-new user with nothing saved yet**.

**Please try:**
1. **The first-run state.** Look at the main area: instead of a blank page it says **"No bookmarks yet — Paste a link above to save your first one."** Click **To read** (→ "Nothing to read yet") and **Archived** (→ "No archived links"). Does each empty view guide you on what to do, rather than looking broken?
2. **Your very first save.** Back on **All**, save `github.com`. The empty message is replaced by your first bookmark. Does that first-save moment feel right?

And one related empty case I can describe rather than stage: when you search and **nothing matches**, the list shows a **"No matches — try different words, or clear the filters"** message (you saw this style earlier in the search screen). And with no bookmarks yet, the **"Filter by tag" bar is simply empty** since you have no tags. Are you happy with those, or would you like to see either as a live screen?

Assuming these land, I believe we've now covered the main flows *and* their edge cases — empty data, invalid input, duplicates, unreadable pages, and overflow. After this I'd be ready to propose moving into building the real thing.
